name: Acme Notes facts
summary: The demo app's facts: what it does, where the facts live, and what never to say about it.

nodes.title: Writing about Acme Notes
nodes.sub: Any post, reply or answer that names it

nodes.title: What it is
nodes.body:
- A free, open-source markdown notes app that keeps notes as plain files in a folder.
- Repo, README and CHANGELOG: the links on this node.

nodes.title: Never say
nodes.body:
- No real-time sync: sync runs on a timer.
- No end-to-end encryption claims: notes are plain files.
- `playbook/qc/lists.json` never_say holds these as patterns.

nodes.title: Competitors
nodes.body:
- Never named in an original post.
- In a reply: only a sourced, neutral, brief claim, leading with what Acme Notes does.

nodes.sub: Every claim traced to a source
